title: Relevant coordinates
statement: For a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, let its relevant coordinates be the finite set of all $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$ for which $f$ is relevant in coordinate $i$.
caveat: The definition of relevance, `IsRelevant`, is not included, so its precise meaning cannot be stated from this payload.
